podcast.title: Guitar Resurgence (1990s)
podcast.body: The alternative revolution of the 1990s, alongside Grunge, played a crucial role in revitalizing the presence of guitars in popular music. This movement contributed to a widespread return to guitar-centric songwriting and performance. "Then along came Grunge and the alternative revolution in the 1990s. What did you have? Lots of guitars."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Story of the Electric Guitar - Part 3

podcast.title: Scott Weiland's Emergence (1990s)
podcast.body: Scott Weiland was recognized as one of the best performers to emerge from the alternative revolution of the 1990s, showcasing his prowess and confidence as a frontman. "Certainly one of the best to emerge out of the alternative revolution of the 90s."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
